title: Activity lap
description: A normalized lap or split belonging to an activity.

lapIndex.description: The zero-based lap order encoded as a string.

startTime.description: The lap start time in ISO 8601 format.

elapsedTimeSeconds.description: The lap elapsed time in seconds.

movingTimeSeconds.description: The lap moving time in seconds.

averageHeartRateBpm.description: The average lap heart rate in beats per minute.

maximumHeartRateBpm.description: The maximum lap heart rate in beats per minute.

averagePowerWatts.description: The average lap power in watts.

averageCadenceRpm.description: The average lap cadence in revolutions per minute.
